deadline.value: January 8 for Fall (September) entry for all applicants; Fall entry only, reviewed by committee in March/April.
deadline.quote: The Admissions committee for Statistics reviews applications in March / April. | Canadian, US and International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 8

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to select a Statistics faculty member as their supervisor when applying; the page does not say a confirmed agreement is required.
supervisor.quote: Statistics MSc and PhD programs are research-intensive and because of this, applicants are requested to select one of our faculty members to be their supervisor and preside over an applicant’s program.

funding.value: The department's funding page lists fellowships and awards but no guaranteed PhD stipend.

entry_route.value: A master's in Statistics (or equivalent) with a 3.0 GPA in the last two years is required.
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree (or equivalent) in Statistics with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 in the last two years of full-time university study.

notes: Fall entry only. Research statement required.
